steps.description: Retrieved memory is dynamically assembled into a token-budget-aware context payload via POST /api/v1/context/retrieve . Redundant facts are compressed to preserve model context windows.

steps.title: Generate & Self-Learn BYOK ROUTING
steps.description: Context is injected into the system prompt for inference. Native BYOK encryption lets you route requests directly to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or DeepSeek while session mining captures user feedback.

pages.raw_text: Platform / Platform Overview Platform Overview Copy page Everything you need to build, manage, and scale persistent intelligence with PiyAPI. Production Architecture • Updated recently PiyAPI provides the infrastructure for persistent intelligence across AI applications. The platform manages memory, context, and retrieval as distinct layers, allowing applications to store relevant information and recall it precisely when needed rather than relying on ephemeral session state. This document introduces the core building blocks of PiyAPI and describes how they compose into a working system for AI agents and applications. Core Concepts Explore the five fundamental pillars of persistent intelligence. Click any concept frame to highlight it and inspect its active parameters: Persistent Memory Long-term storage referenced via memory_id . Backed by the Unified 8-Operator Surface . store() retrieve() update() delete() merge() summarize() pin() verify() Context Assembled data passed via context object. Token-budget-aware context assembly for LLM system prompts via POST /api/v1/context/retrieve . POST /api/v1/context/retrieve → Retrieval RRF_K=30 • 11 Signals Query via client.search() . Hybrid search engine combining dense vector similarity (HNSW via pgvector ) and BM25 trigram full-text search, fused using Reciprocal Rank Fusion ( RRF_K=30 ). UnifiedScorer (11 Signals in 1 Database Pass) → Knowledge Structured domain data accessible through knowledge.query() . PiyGraph Knowledge Graph tracking real-world validity ( valid_at ) separately from system recording time ( system_at ). PiyGraph Temporal KG → Users & Sessions Scoped via user_id identifiers. Enterprise multi-tenancy enforced via strict namespace isolation ( X-Namespace-Prefix header) and automated PHI/PII privacy redaction. Namespace Scoping & Privacy → Persistent Memory Persistent memory provides durable, bitemporal fact storage isolated by workspace and tenant. All state mutations run through the atomic 8-operator interface: store() , retrieve() , update() , delete() , merge() , summarize() , pin() , and verify() . ℹ Platform Note: PiyAPI separates persistent memory from the application logic so your AI system can retrieve relevant context when it needs it. Redundant facts are compressed to preserve model context windows. 05 Generate & Self-Learn BYOK ROUTING Context is injected into the system prompt for inference. Developer Onboarding • 5 min setup • Live Endpoints PiyAPI decouples cognitive memory from stateless LLM inference. Follow the four-step setup pipeline below to store durable user preferences and recall them in real-time: 01 Install Official SDK or Connect via REST INGRESS PROTOCOL Install the lightweight, production-hardened client for Node.js/TypeScript or Python with native streaming and auto-reconnecting WebSocket support. 02 Authenticate with Workspace API Key AUTH & BYOK Initialize the client using your live API key ( sk_live_... ). Optionally attach BYOK headers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek) to route inference directly through your enterprise accounts. 03 Persist Bitemporal Memory Facts O(1) MEMORY STORE Store conversational statements, entity attributes, or structured metadata. PiyAPI automatically computes 1536-dim vector embeddings and stamps bitemporal intervals ( valid_at vs system_at ). 04 Retrieve Context & Complete Model Prompts HYBRID RECALL Query memory via client.search() or dynamic context assembly via POST /api/v1/context/retrieve with token-budget enforcement and automatic PHI/PII redaction. Step 1 • Installation Choose between our official TypeScript library or Python package. Both clients feature automatic token-budget management, connection pooling, and resilient retry logic: terminal Copy # Install TypeScript SDK npm install @piyapi/sdk # Or install Python SDK pip install piyapi-memory Step 2 • Initialize Client & Retrieve Context Authenticate your client and execute an end-to-end memory store and contextual recall in a single script: quickstart.ts Copy import { PiyAPIClient } from '@piyapi/sdk'; const client = new PiyAPIClient({ apiKey: process.env.PIYAPI_API_KEY || 'sk_live_...', namespace: 'enterprise_workspace_prod' }); // 1. Store persistent fact await client.memories.create({ content: "User requested quarterly forecast in EUR currency with dark mode theme", tags: ["preferences", "finance"], metadata: { user_id: "usr_9918", session_id: "sess_441" } }); // 2. Retrieve assembled context const context = await client.context.retrieve({ query: "What currency should we render the charts in?", user_id: "usr_9918", token_budget: 1500 }); console.log('Assembled Context:', context.rendered_prompt); 💡 Enterprise Tip: For high-throughput environments, set the X-Namespace-Prefix header to isolate multi-tenant customer records at the database partition layer.

steps.title: Unified 8-Operator Memory Surface ATOMIC ENGINE
steps.description: A unified interface exposing store , retrieve , update , delete , merge , summarize , pin , and verify for fine-grained cognitive control.

steps.title: Bitemporal Validity Tracking TIME TRAVEL
steps.description: Every memory record independently stores valid_at (when the event occurred in the real world) and system_at (when it was logged in the database) to eliminate factual drift.

steps.title: Speculative Memory Branching WHAT-IF SIMULATION
steps.description: Branch off memory graphs into isolated sandbox environments using POST /api/v1/branches , simulate agent actions, and merge diffs back to main after user approval.

steps.title: Pinned Memory Guarantees ZERO DECAY
steps.description: Mark critical compliance rules, user constraints, and security policies as pinned to bypass recency decay curves and guarantee 100% prompt recall.

code_blocks.code:
from piyapi_memory import PiyAPIClient

client = PiyAPIClient(api_key="sk_live_...")

# 1. Store memory with bitemporal valid_at interval
mem = client.memories.store(
    content="Patient is allergic to penicillin and penicillin-family antibiotics",
    valid_at="2024-01-15T00:00:00Z",
    tags=["medical", "allergies", "critical"],
    user_id="pat_4091"
)

# 2. Pin memory to guarantee 100% recall priority
client.memories.pin(memory_id=mem.id)

# 3. Merge two related memories atomically
merged = client.memories.merge(
    source_ids=[mem.id, "mem_prev_819"],
    summary="Patient has verified life-threatening allergy to all penicillin derivatives"
)

pages.raw_text: Platform / Memory Persistent Memory & 8-Operator Surface Copy page Durable, bitemporal fact storage governed by an atomic eight-operator cognitive surface. Memory Substrate • Unified 8-Operator Surface • Bitemporal Persistent memory provides durable state retention across multiple conversational turns, user sessions, and AI agents. Explore the core architectural pillars below: 01 Unified 8-Operator Memory Surface ATOMIC ENGINE A unified interface exposing store , retrieve , update , delete , merge , summarize , pin , and verify for fine-grained cognitive control. 02 Bitemporal Validity Tracking TIME TRAVEL Every memory record independently stores valid_at (when the event occurred in the real world) and system_at (when it was logged in the database) to eliminate factual drift. 03 Speculative Memory Branching WHAT-IF SIMULATION Branch off memory graphs into isolated sandbox environments using POST /api/v1/branches , simulate agent actions, and merge diffs back to main after user approval. 04 Pinned Memory Guarantees ZERO DECAY Mark critical compliance rules, user constraints, and security policies as pinned to bypass recency decay curves and guarantee 100% prompt recall. The Unified 8-Operator Surface All mutations on persistent memory execute through eight standardized atomic operators: store() Insert new facts with embeddings & bitemporal timestamps. retrieve() Fetch context vectors via 11-signal UnifiedScorer. update() Patch fact content while maintaining historical audit trail. delete() Cryptographic shredding & soft-delete compliance flags. merge() Synthesize multiple redundant memories into unified knowledge. summarize() Generate loss-less semantic summaries for long conversation threads. pin() Lock high-priority rules with infinite recency half-life. verify() Cross-validate fact coherence against knowledge graph edges. Python SDK Memory Implementation Execute atomic memory operations using the official Python client: memory_operations.py Copy from piyapi_memory import PiyAPIClient client = PiyAPIClient(api_key="sk_live_...") # 1. Store memory with bitemporal valid_at interval mem = client.memories.store( content="Patient is allergic to penicillin and penicillin-family antibiotics", valid_at="2024-01-15T00:00:00Z", tags=["medical", "allergies", "critical"], user_id="pat_4091" ) # 2. Pin memory to guarantee 100% recall priority client.memories.pin(memory_id=mem.id) # 3. Merge two related memories atomically merged = client.memories.merge( source_ids=[mem.id, "mem_prev_819"], summary="Patient has verified life-threatening allergy to all penicillin derivatives" )

sections.heading: Python Search Example
paragraphs: Execute a hybrid multi-signal search with custom score thresholding:

steps.title: UnifiedScorer (11 Signals in 1 Pass) RRF_K=30
steps.description: Simultaneously evaluates dense cosine similarity, BM25 trigram text score, recency half-life decay, entity overlap, contradiction penalty, and pin weights.

steps.title: Dense Vector Search (pgvector HNSW) EMBEDDING ENGINE
steps.description: Indexes 1536-dimensional vectors using Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs, yielding sub-10ms nearest neighbor recall with 99.2% precision.

steps.title: Sparse BM25 Trigram Search EXACT KEYWORDS
steps.description: Captures rare entity IDs, acronyms, code identifiers, and email addresses that dense embeddings frequently blur.

steps.title: Configurable Hybrid Alpha Blend SCORING CONTROL
steps.description: Tune the balance between semantic meaning and exact keyword match using alpha (e.g. alpha=0.7 for 70% vector + 30% BM25).

code_blocks.code:
from piyapi_memory import PiyAPIClient

client = PiyAPIClient(api_key="sk_live_...")

# Execute hybrid search with UnifiedScorer
response = client.search(
    query="What AWS region does the customer require for data residency?",
    user_id="usr_8821",
    limit=5,
    min_score=0.35,
    alpha=0.65 # 65% dense vector + 35% BM25
)

for item in response.results:
    print(f"[{item.score:.3f}] {item.content} (Vector: {item.vector_score}, BM25: {item.bm25_score})")

rows: Cosine similarity across 1536-dim embedding space via pgvector HNSW
Sparse term-frequency / inverse-document-frequency for exact code and identifier recall
Exponential decay curve: score = score * (0.5 ^ (days_elapsed / half_life))
Guaranteed +1.0 priority boost for immutable compliance rules and user constraints
Jaccard similarity on named entity recognition (NER) tokens extracted from query
Hard boundary evaluation against valid_at intervals to prevent chronological anachronisms
